title: One TTL cache sharing the rate limiter sweep core
evidence: rate-limiter.ts sweepExpired is the one sweep; createRateLimiter, createQuotaCounter and subscription-gateway.server.ts summaryCache use it (same intervals, same now > expiry rule, unref'd). Readers keep their own expiry check: the limiters serve up to and including resetAt, the summary cache only before expiresAt, so no shared get was made. lab-batches.server.ts armSweep left as is: async deletes at Anthropic, an overlap guard, two maps (activeBatches by servedAt or createdAt into undeletedBatches) and armed on first upload, none of which the sync expiry sweep holds. Bound: a map holds the keys written in the last TTL + sweep interval; no hard cap, so a burst of distinct keys inside one window is unbounded
